📚 Bulk Archive Import

Long-term archive for historical audits. Stays in your browser.

Tip: Drag your year of monthly ALE contact log CSVs into the file picker. Each entry is deduped on import (re-uploading is safe).

📋 Course Enrollment Snapshot

Stores who is enrolled in what, and their start/end dates. Used by the Audit feature.

Tip: Each upload creates a snapshot keyed by today's date. Upload weekly to build historical accuracy. Re-uploading on the same day overwrites that day's snapshot.
